name: Pixel
description: Android's Material 3 Expressive, so far for the shade (notifications, controls, banners)
author: Launcher
_about: Pixel's look as a theme on iOS 27's (docs/SHADE_PIXEL_EVALUATION.md, step 1): written by tools/design/build_pixel_theme.py from AOSP's numbers and captures of the Android 17 emulator's shade. Only what differs from iOS 27 is written here; its colours are the phone's palette by role, as a Pixel's.

sys.font.text.src: judged:Pixel draws its system UI in Google Sans Flex (Material 3 Expressive)

sys.font.display.src: judged:Pixel draws its system UI in Google Sans Flex (Material 3 Expressive)

sys.color.source.src: judged:a Pixel always takes the wallpaper's colours (Material You)

comp.cc.module.material.src: judged:back to the component (iOS 27's Material You sets its own tinted glass here)

comp.cc.well.material.src: judged:back to the component (iOS 27's Material You sets its own tinted glass here)

comp.cc.background.material.src: judged:back to the component (iOS 27's Material You sets its own tinted veil here)

component.panel.material.src: measured:the shade's veil over a blur, about 55 % light in light and 72 % dark in dark (docs/PIXEL_PROFILE.md, the captures)

component.control.material.src: measured:Android 17 emulator shade, 2026-10-19 (tools/shots/shade_qs.png, shade_qqs.png) against its palette: a tile that is off is a light layer of about 45 % over the veil (light); dark judged alike

component.control.on-material.src: kit:AOSP SystemUI qs/panels/ui/compose/infinitegrid/Tile.kt: activeTileColors, background primary (the capture: exactly the palette's primary)

component.control.corner.src: kit:AOSP SystemUI qs/panels/ui/compose/infinitegrid/CommonTile.kt: InactiveCornerRadius 50 dp on a 72 dp tile, a pill (half its height); on, 24 dp (ActiveTileCornerRadius): no token for the corner when on yet

component.control.symbol.src: measured:Android 17 emulator shade, 2026-10-19 (tools/shots/shade_qs.png, shade_qqs.png) against its palette: a small tile's symbol about 25 dp across (CommonTileDefaults.IconSize 32 dp with its padding)

component.control.label-color.src: kit:AOSP SystemUI qs/panels/ui/compose/infinitegrid/Tile.kt: inactiveTileColors, label onSurfaceVariant (on, onPrimary: no token for a name when on yet)

comp.cc.well.symbol.src: kit:AOSP SystemUI qs/panels/ui/compose/infinitegrid/CommonTile.kt: LargeTileIconSize 28 dp with its padding, about 24 dp drawn

component.slider.corner.src: kit:AOSP compose/core PlatformSlider.kt: the track rounded by half its size (a pill) on a 72 dp module

component.slider.expanded-corner.src: judged:the opened slider as a pill too

comp.cc.button.material.src: judged:as Quick Settings' round footer buttons (qs_footer_action_button_size 48 dp), surfaceContainerHighest

comp.cc.button.size.src: judged:larger than iOS 27's (Pixel's are 48 dp; kept within the status row)

comp.cc.edit.handle-color.src: judged:the resize handle in primary (Pixel's editor marks the selected tile in primary)

comp.cc.gallery.sheet.src: judged:the gallery as a Material sheet (surfaceContainer)

comp.cc.gallery.entry.src: judged:entries as tiles that are off

comp.cc.gallery.corner.src: judged:a Material sheet's top corners (28 dp)

component.notification.material.src: measured:Android 17 emulator shade, 2026-10-19 (tools/shots/shade_qs.png, shade_qqs.png) against its palette: cards opaque in surfaceContainerHigh (#e7e6ef against the palette's #e7e7f1)

component.notification.floating-material.src: judged:a heads-up notification is the same opaque card

component.notification.corner.src: kit:AOSP SystemUI dimens.xml notification_corner_radius 28 dp (between joined cards 4 dp: no token for that yet)

component.notification.title.src: kit:AOSP core dimens.xml notification_big_title_text_size 16 sp (the 2025 template as captured), titleMedium

component.notification.body.src: kit:AOSP core dimens.xml notification_text_size 14 sp, bodyMedium

component.notification.time.src: kit:AOSP core dimens.xml notification_subtext_size 12 sp, bodySmall

component.notification.gap.src: measured:Android 17 emulator shade, 2026-10-19 (tools/shots/shade_qs.png, shade_qqs.png) against its palette: a section's cards joined about 2 dp apart

comp.nc.stack.shelf-show.src: judged:a Pixel's collapsed group is one card with a count, no shelves below it

comp.nc.count.fill.src: judged:the group's count on a primary chip

comp.nc.overlay.material.src: measured:the shade's veil over a blur, as Quick Settings' (docs/PIXEL_PROFILE.md, the captures)

comp.nc.text-shadow-color.src: judged:Material puts no shadow under words

comp.nc.look.card-color.src: judged:the held card as the cards

comp.banner.system-blur.src: judged:a Pixel's heads-up notification is an opaque card (no blur behind it)
